title: Micro-catalog for admin utilities & taskified runbooks
creator: Noah Patel
description: Build a lightweight, discoverable micro-catalog of small admin utilities ("adminlets") that can be surfaced in the Console and invoked as first-class taskified runbooks. The micro-catalog is intended to be the canonical registry for short, safe operator actions (eg. rotate-keys, cache-invalidate, safe-restart-service) with typed inputs, RBAC checks, dry-run and auditing baked in. Deliverables: (1) a catalog schema + storage (immutable version tags), (2) a runtime wrapper that enforces parameter types, permission checks and sandbox mode, (3) a task adapter that converts a catalog entry to a runbook-task with provenance and telemetry, and (4) Console wiring to search and invoke with a confirmable safety flow.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog schema defined and documented with versioning rules and example entries
Runtime wrapper enforces input validation and returns structured success/failure objects
Each adminlet supports dry-run that simulates changes without side effects
Invocation flow logs provenance to the admin ledger and emits telemetry events consumed by Console
A sample set of 6 vetted adminlets (rotate-keys, invalidate-prefix, graceful-restart, scale-service, revoke-session, apply-config-patch) implemented and code-reviewed
E2E test harness exists: CLI/SDK -> task adapter -> runtime wrapper -> sandboxed executor with smoke tests

review_feedback: Security: require explicit allowlist of affected resources and a rollback plan in metadata for high-risk adminlets.
SRE: add precheck step that verifies health endpoints and rejects an action if cluster quorum is missing.
PM: prefer search-friendly tag fields (service:, area:, risk:) for Console filtering.
Design: two-step confirm for high risk, inline dry-run output preview, and link to runbook docs.
tradeoffs: Tight validation increases safety but makes ad-hoc emergency scripts harder; decided to add an 'emergency' flag that requires extra audit and a second approver.
Implementing sandboxed container execution adds ops overhead; initial rollout will use a software-level sandbox with a clear migration path to containerized isolation in Q1 2026.
Indexing all catalog entries in Console increases latency on listing; opted for a periodic sync (5m) with on-demand refresh option.
